fit_reason: Whole Wellcraft 190 Classic runabout with trailer, listed by a private owner in the boats-by-owner section.
findings: Hull bottom below the blue stripe looks dull and slightly hazy, with greenish smudges where the trailer rollers contact it
Off-white topsides and deck gelcoat look somewhat flat rather than glossy
Cream vinyl seats in the cockpit show light dinginess and grime in the seams
Swim platform at the stern looks weathered and grayed
Light scuffing on the lower hull near the bow
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Wellcraft 190 Classic. It looks well kept, but the lower hull looks a bit dull with some roller marks, and the cream seats could use a cleaning. We do mobile pre-sale gelcoat polish and interior details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
